U.S. President Donald Trump on Oct. 5 said that Washington will help Russia manage its plague scare as the country faces reported quarantines.

When asked by reporters about the plague in Russia, Trump confirmed he's aware of the situation and said that the U.S. will "help them."

"I hate to see them having it; it's a rough disease," he added. "We'll help anybody that has that kind of problem, were willing to help."

On Oct. 4, Russian officials and media reported that an aluminum factory and multiple hospitals in Russia's Irkutsk Oblast have instituted preventative safety measures, including quarantines and mask mandates, following a laboratory worker's recent death by the plague.

Actual Article Body:
President Donald Trump dubbed South Carolina Democrat Annie Andrews, who’s running against Sen. Darline Graham Nordone (R-SC), with the nickname “Trannie” in an effort to discredit her.

“Annie ‘Trannie’ Andrews is running against our wonderful Darline Graham for the Senate in South Carolina,” Trump posted on Truth Social. “For years my dear friend Lindsey would say that, ‘Darline is the finest, most reliable, and one of the smartest people I have ever known.’ He would then always add, ‘Also, the most loyal!’ Oftentimes I would be upset with Lindsey for saying this, because I thought I had all of those qualities.”
